description: This file contains unit tests for the OrganizationService class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It includes setup of test data, mocking dependencies, and test cases for retrieving and saving organization information.

classes.name: OrganizationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the OrganizationService methods, including retrieving and saving organization data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the OrganizationService instance and loads test data from fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests retrieving organization general information via the service, ensuring it correctly calls the DAO and returns expected data.

methods.name: testSaveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests saving organization information through the service, verifying that it interacts properly with the DAO and returns the saved entity.
